map.转换系数=参考画幅对角线÷当前画幅对角线；系数越大，等效焦距越长、视角越窄。参考: Conversion factor = reference-format diagonal ÷ current-format diagonal. A larger factor means a longer equivalent focal length and a narrower angle of view. Switching the reference format only changes the reference-format equivalent focal length; lens type is always judged by the full-frame equivalent.
map.等效焦距与镜头类型: Equivalent focal length and lens type
map.以 50mm 镜头、全画幅传感器（对角线 43.27mm）为例，全画幅等效 50: Example: a 50mm lens on full frame (43.27mm diagonal) is 50mm full-frame equivalent and is classed as standard/medium. Switching the diagonal reference to M4/3 (21.64mm) gives about 25mm reference-format equivalent, but the full-frame equivalent stays 50mm, so the class does not change. On an APS-C body (28.2mm), 50mm is about 77mm full-frame equivalent and remains standard/medium—it does not become wide-angle just because the reference format changed.
